strategic_horizon.medium_term_goal: Prove the first real industry benchmark end-to-end: archived original evidence must support no-lookahead Reality + Expectation + Outcome replay across a meaningful cycle, using reusable primitives rather than lithium-specific hacks.
strategic_horizon.short_term_goal: Prove the evidence-final transition on the first sealed shard. UP-CHEMICALS blind memory remains frozen within the 683 raw / 625 formal / 58 legacy campaign checkpoint. Self-verification discovery run 001 has completed six bounded query families and produced three claim-scoped evidence tasks; the next work is to fetch/archive original documents and extract traceable fragments rather than continue broad search.
strategic_horizon.next_big_step: Complete the first archived Kwinana/Kemerton/chemistry-expectation evidence trajectories with valid-time, known-time and expectation-horizon semantics, then assemble the first small no-lookahead Reality + Expectation + Outcome replay fixture and use it to test whether Longcycle's primitives generalize beyond lithium-specific prose.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not reopen sealed blind memory, do not keep broad-searching after exact primary targets are known, and do not build a general dispatcher before repeated bounded tasks justify it. Search is discovery; archived source fragments decide evidence; not_found is not false.
parallel_permanent_tracks: Keep current-source collection source-first/archive-now so today's original material does not become tomorrow's recovery gap.

The next product-level proof is whether Longcycle can preserve original documents and extract claim-scoped evidence into replayable expectation-to-outcome trajectories without contaminating the sealed memory vintage.
